plot_edf_sweeps: plot error empirical distribution functions for each sweep in a list of sweep results
plot_values_scatter: plot scatter plots of error versus metrics for each sweep with filter ranges highlighted
plot_trends_across_sweeps: plot metric trends across sweeps showing min, max, median, and best values per sweep
plot_curves_per_epoch: plot training, testing, and EMA metric curves versus epoch for the best jobs per sweep
plot_models_visualization: plot model architecture visualization showing block widths for regnet, anynet, or effnet models per sweep
